pages.title: Head in the Clouds
pages.text: Finish a substantial living-transport project with an actual mounting action.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Grow the companion and craft its harness by the native recipe. A passenger and a construction project are optional. This quest checks mounting.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Equip an adult Happy Ghast with a Harness and mount it. Carry multiple players, with the first rider controlling flight.
